function startFly(

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/fly.ts:30

Arms a fly-to tween: destination is offset units along the current camera→body direction (or straight above when the camera is too close to define a direction), target tracks the body's live world position.

Parameters

s

SFState

Engine state.

track

() => | { x: number; y: number; z: number; } | null

Body world-position getter — re-resolved per frame so a moving (rider-mounted) anchor can't leave the camera landing on a stale spot; null return freezes the last destination.

offset

number

Standoff distance — scaled per body so giants frame wide.

done?

() => void

Optional completion callback.

Returns

void
